title: Name SHA-256 repositories as unsupported in engram source instead of "Git status did not report a HEAD commit"
outcome: Name SHA-256 repositories as unsupported in engram source instead of "Git status did not report a HEAD commit"
acceptance: engram source on a repository created with --object-format=sha256 refuses with a reason that says SHA-256 repositories are unsupported, not that Git status reported no HEAD commit
A behaviour test drives that refusal through the CLI on a real SHA-256 fixture repository
